subject: POC timeline & milestones — ACME Industries
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya.desai@acme.com>, Jared Stone <jared.stone@acme.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Aug 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC timeline & milestones — ACME Industries

Hi Priya / Jared —

Thanks again for a productive call today. Per our discussion, I wanted to capture the proposed POC scope, success criteria, and a tentative timeline so we can align on next steps. Please review and let me know if anything is missing or needs to change.

POC goal: Validate Redwood Inference to reduce token cost by >=20% vs current infra while keeping 95th %-tile latency under 300ms for production-style queries.

Proposed success criteria (deliverables):
- Cost: >=20% reduction in per-token billable cost measured across the week-long test set (pricing baseline: your current cloud serving costs)
- Latency: 95th %-tile < 300ms for the target query distribution
- Functional: parity on output quality for the evaluation prompt set (BLEU/ROUGE subjective pass on 90% of prompts)
- Integrations: live test with your inference pipeline using Redwood SDK and secure VPC peering

High-level timeline (target kickoff week of Sep 6):
1) Kickoff (week of Sep 6) — align on test dataset, success metrics, and access (2-hour session)
2) Week 1 (Sep 7-13) — infra setup, VPC access, baseline collection
3) Week 2 (Sep 14-20) — run Redwood variants, initial tuning, daily check-ins
4) Week 3 (Sep 21-27) — final runs, regen of evaluation set, prepare readout
5) Final readout (Sep 28) — 45-minute presentation of results and recommended next steps

Ownership:
- Redwood: Marissa (POC lead), Ethan (engineer on-call), David (solution architect for integration)
- Acme: Priya (project sponsor), Jared (integration lead)

Action items / next steps:
- Priya/Jared: Confirm kickoff date (we suggested week of Sep 6) and provide initial access details (test dataset S3 path or a shared Drive link)
- Marissa: Share success-criteria spreadsheet and kickoff agenda (attached)
- Ethan: Draft initial infra checklist and provide required firewall/VPC rules

Attachments: ACME-POC-Success-Criteria.xlsx; ACME-POC-Kickoff-Agenda.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to running this with your team.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Associate Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. This aligns closely with our internal expectations. A few clarifications and tweaks on success criteria:

- Quality metric: we'll provide a representative evaluation prompt set of ~1,000 queries; for subjectivity we'll use a 3-point human review on ~200 sampled outputs and expect >=85% pass rather than 90%.
- Latency: can we set two buckets — interactive (95th < 300ms) and batch (average < 600ms) — since we have both workloads.
- Cost: happy to aim for >=20% reduction but would like a stretch target of 25% if feasible.

Kickoff week: the team prefers Sep 6 or Sep 7 for the kickoff session (local team availability: Tue/Wed morning PT). Please schedule a 90-minute kickoff to allow time for access walkthrough.

Access: we'll grant a read-only S3 path for the evaluation dataset and create a service account for Redwood with limited S3 read + KMS decrypt. I'll send the IAM details once IT approves (targeting EOD Tue Aug 31).

I'll plan to be the exec sponsor and Jared will be the day-to-day integration lead. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Priya Desai
Director of ML Platforms
Acme Industries
priya.desai@acme.com | +1 (212) 555-4123

Marissa —

Thanks for sending this. I'll take point on the infra checklist and initial config once we have the IAM role from Priya. Quick notes from my side:

- I'll prepare a pre-kickoff runbook that lists exact firewall rules, VPC peering steps, expected S3 prefixes, and example API calls to validate connectivity.
- Suggest we use weekly 30-min standups (Mon/Wed flexible) during the active 2-week run window — keeps it light but consistent.
- I'll add Ethan Park (me) as on-call outside business hours for run execution.

I can have the runbook and the first draft of the infra checklist ready by EOD Wed Sep 1. Marissa, can you send the calendar invite for Sep 6 kickoff and include the Zoom link + agenda?

-Ethan
